title: Valuation Basis Reference: Host Damage Protection (HostCover) Levels
content:
The **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** level fixes four valuation terms: whether damaged items are paid at depreciated value, the depreciation schedule by item age, whether a deep-cleaning claim is reduced by the cleaning fee collected on the stay, and how guest payments reduce the payable amount.

## Depreciation by level

| HostCover level | Items paid at depreciated value |
|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | Yes |
| HostCover Standard | Yes |
| HostCover Plus | Yes |
| HostCover Premier | Yes |
| HostCover Elite | No (replacement cost) |
| HostCover Estate | No (replacement cost) |

"No" means damaged items are paid at replacement cost rather than depreciated value.

## Depreciation schedule (the same schedule is listed for every level)

| Item age band | Percent deducted from the verified loss |
|---|---|
| 0 to 12 months | 0.00 |
| 13 to 36 months | 20.00 |
| 37 to 60 months | 40.00 |
| 61 months and over | 60.00 |

## Other valuation terms (every level)

| Term | Every level |
|---|---|
| Deep-cleaning claim reduced by the cleaning fee collected on the stay | Yes |
| How guest payments reduce the payable amount | guest payments recorded on the claim are subtracted from the depreciated loss before the deductible |

## Reading notes

- On HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate the schedule is listed but items are not paid at depreciated value, because those levels pay replacement cost.
- The schedule bands are contiguous: an item recorded as 12 months old falls in the 0 to 12 band, one recorded as 13 months old in the 13 to 36 band, 36 and 37 months sit either side of the next boundary, and 60 and 61 months either side of the last.
